scientific_integrity: The analytic proof relies on positive Glauber rates, compactness on the simplex, C2 singular limiting equations and nondegenerate fold continuation. Finite numerical checks are supporting tests rather than proof of infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the deterministic spatially homogeneous mean-field flow in the high-drive scaling k-b-log(k)=O(1). It does not count nonstationary attractors, stochastic or spatial states; the equality c=c* requires the displayed finite-b fold location. Historical priority is provisional; independent scientific validation is not performed.
title: A logarithmic strong-drive fold and complete stationary-state census for the active three-state Potts flow
